meta_description: Casa Rossa is a restored 200-year-old Tuscan farmhouse with five en-suite bedrooms, a saltwater pool and 360-degree views over the Brunello vineyards of Montalcino.

hero.heading: Casa Rossa
hero.text: A two-hundred-year-old farmhouse at the top of the hill, among the Brunello vineyards of Luce and the historic Castelgiocondo estate.

welcome.heading: Where every window frames the vineyards
welcome.lede: Casa Rossa sits on the highest point of the Frescobaldi Castelgiocondo estate, with views in every direction across vines, forest and the hills of the Val d'Orcia.
welcome.text: Restored with patience over a decade, the house has been brought to life with style and comfort in every detail: crystal chandeliers and deep sofas, old chestnut beams and a professional kitchen, quiet corners for reading and a saltwater pool for long afternoons. It is a home first, full of character, art and books, and made for sharing.
welcome.text_muted: The house is surrounded by a hectare and a half of olive groves, fruit trees and a garden of native plants, where swallows nest under the eaves and owls call at night. The castle is a fifteen-minute walk along the white roads, and Montalcino is a fifteen-minute drive.

story.heading: A ruin, a decade, and a great deal of love

photo.alt: Stone courtyard entrance of Casa Rossa with climbing vines

paragraphs: Casa Rossa is a *podere*, one of the farmhouses where the estate's workers once lived. Two outside staircases tell you two families shared it, with the animals below and the people above. It was a working farm until the 1960s, and the bread oven in the garden is so large it probably baked for every podere on the estate.

We bought it in 1999, when parts of the roof were missing and some rooms were too dangerous to enter. Restoring it took ten years. The outside is almost exactly as it was; inside, original stone and beams sit alongside touches of Rococo, industrial pieces and contemporary design. It has been our family home for nearly twenty years.
story.quote: Comfortable, friendly, elegant in places, with soul.
story.quote_close: A house that is well loved and welcoming.
